name: Central
beschreibung: Hotel Central is located in the center of St. Johann in Tirol. The surroundings offer access to shopping facilities and dining establishments. The train station and the valley station of the mountain railways are within walking distance. The hotel has rooms with en-suite bathrooms and some with a balcony. A restaurant with regional cuisine is available in the hotel. Amenities include a wellness area and a lounge. The atmosphere is informal and geared toward practical needs. The hotel is suitable for guests looking for a central starting point for activities in the region.
